curzon gate.name: Curzon Gate
curzon gate.description: Curzon Gate is a prominent landmark in Bardhaman, built to commemorate the coronation of Maharaja Bijay Chand Mahatab. It stands at the entrance of the grand palace complex.
curzon gate.history: The gate was constructed around the early 20th century. It is believed to be named after Lord Curzon, the then Viceroy of India, though local stories and exact dates may vary.
fun_facts: Locals also call it Bijoy Toran.
It becomes beautifully lit up during festivals and special occasions.
It marks the symbolic entry to the royal area of Bardhaman.
visit_tips: Best enjoyed in the evening when the lights are on.
Good spot for quick photos while passing through the town center.
Traffic can be busy around the gate; be careful while taking photos on the road.

victoria memorial.name: Victoria Memorial
victoria memorial.description: Victoria Memorial is a large marble building dedicated to the memory of Queen Victoria, now a museum and tourist attraction.
victoria memorial.history: The construction started in 1906 and was completed in 1921. It was built in Indo-Saracenic style with a mix of British and Mughal elements.
fun_facts: Surrounded by beautiful gardens popular with locals and tourists.
The museum inside contains paintings, artifacts, and historical documents.
The night lighting and sound-and-light shows are very popular.
visit_tips: Go early morning or late afternoon to avoid heat.
Museum entry has a separate ticket; outside garden has its own timing.
Keep some time extra to walk around the gardens.

hazarduari palace.name: Hazarduari Palace
hazarduari palace.description: Hazarduari Palace is a famous palace with a thousand doors, located in Murshidabad, once the capital of Bengal.
hazarduari palace.history: Built in the 19th century during the rule of Nawab Nazim Humayun Jah, it served as a royal residence and administrative building.
fun_facts: Called 'Hazarduari' because it is said to have 1000 doors, including real and fake ones.
Now maintained as a museum by the Archaeological Survey of India.
The palace complex also has Imambara and other historical structures.
visit_tips: Photography may be restricted inside certain parts of the museum.
Carry water; summer can be quite hot.
